1048.description: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1112.description: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees in and curl the hips up, a direct ab move.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

1176.description: A front raise performed lying on an incline bench to reduce swinging and isolate the front delts.
instructions: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

1304.description: Push a medicine ball away from your chest and catch it again in a quick, repeated flow. It builds explosive chest and arm power.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest level.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the medicine ball away from your chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the medicine ball back to your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。

1368.description: Sit and move your foot in slow circles from the ankle. It warms up the ankle joint and the muscles around the calf.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Lift one leg off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then switch to the other direction.
Repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将一条腿抬离地面，并以圆周运动旋转脚踝。
在一个方向上转所需的圈数，然后切换到另一个方向。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

1432.description: A pull-up done on an assisted machine that takes part of your body weight. It builds the lats and upper back while you work up to full pull-ups.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired weight and height settings.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your lats and biceps, and pull yourself up towards the handles.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整至您所需的体重和高度设置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的背阔肌和二头肌，并将自己拉向手柄。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1496.description: Swinging a sledgehammer down onto a tire in a controlled arc. It trains the abs and obliques and also the shoulders and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the sledge hammer with both hands.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Swing the sledge hammer down towards the ground, using your core and upper body strength.
As you swing down, pivot your hips and transfer the force to the hammer.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住大锤。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
使用核心和上半身的力量，将大锤向下挥向地面。
当你向下挥杆时，转动臀部并将力量传递到锤子上。
重复所需的重复次数。

1560.description: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly roll the ball forward, walking your feet out until your upper back is resting on the ball and your legs are extended straight in front of you.
Place your hands on your hips for support.
Engage your core and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your chest lifted.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, and hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your heels and using your hamstrings to pull yourself back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
慢慢地向前滚动球，双脚向外走，直到上背部靠在球上，双腿在身前伸直。
将双手放在臀部上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将上半身降低到地面，保持背部挺直，胸部抬起。
当您感觉到腿筋拉伸时停止，并保持该姿势 20-30 秒。
通过推动脚后跟并使用腿筋将自己拉回来，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1624.description: A bench press with a reverse grip using dumbbells. It targets the upper chest and the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing towards your feet.
Extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your chest, allowing your elbows to flare out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握住，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸直向上伸向天花板，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部，让肘部向两侧张开。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1688.description: A lunge with a torso twist. It works the legs and the obliques.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge, twist your torso to the right, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping forward with your left foot and twisting your torso to the left.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你弓步时，将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的左肘拉向你的右膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向前迈出，并将躯干向左扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1752.description: An incline smith machine extension that lowers the bar toward your forehead. Guided path lets you focus on the triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
Lower the bar slowly towards your forehead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整史密斯机的座椅，使杠铃处于肩部高度。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到前额，保持肘部靠近头部。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1816.description: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1880.description: Leaning stretch for the outer hip and thigh.
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1944.description: A floor stretch for the deep hip rotators and buttock muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2072.description: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2136.description: A cuban press variation with dumbbells that mixes a press and a wrist rotation. Works the shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing down.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, press the dumbbells straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder height, rotating your wrists back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，将哑铃垂直推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃放回至肩膀高度，将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2200.description: A hip thrust done by rolling a ball under your body, which trains the glutes and challenges your balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and your arms by your sides.
Brace your core and press your heels into the ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball drift away.
Repeat for the planned reps, keeping the ball steady.

2328.description: A close-hand push-up with hands on a stability ball. Hits the triceps and chest while the ball challenges your balance.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ball, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地面上，将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在球上，距离略窄于肩宽。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近球，使胸部靠近球。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2712.description: Carrying a heavy sandbag over a set distance to train grip, back and core.
instructions: Lift the sandbag off the floor and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace with short steps.
Keep your posture upright and do not lean back.
Set the bag down under control at the end.

2776.description: Bringing the arm down toward the body from the side, working the lats and chest.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2840.description: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

2904.description: A movement with a power sled where you pull the handles out and back like wings. Works the hamstrings, back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

2968.description: A front squat that flows into an overhead press. It is a hard whole-body move that raises your heart rate.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.

3096.description: A plate-loaded seated row with a narrow grip, one arm at a time for balanced back strength.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.

3224.description: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚并拢站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
跳起来，分开双脚，将手臂举过头顶。
当你落地时，迅速跳回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3288.description: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂伸展并支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3352.description: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.
instructions: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.

3416.description: Circle your shoulders to loosen the joint and ease tension in the upper back.
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

3480.description: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.
instructions: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

3544.description: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the ground and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放回到地面，然后在另一侧重复。

3672.description: A stepping drill moving forward and back with the legs alternating. It raises the heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot, bending your knee and lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and step back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot, alternating legs with each step.
Continue stepping back and forth, maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置。
用右脚蹬地，然后回到起始位置。
用左脚重复该动作，每一步交替双腿。
继续来回走动，保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3736.description: A one-arm overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, which demands wrist and shoulder control.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3864.description: A burpee that adds a kettlebell for extra load, giving you a hard full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.

3928.description: Hinge forward on one leg while the other reaches back. It builds hamstring and glute strength and trains balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3992.description: A wide grip bent over row aimed at the upper back. It builds the lats and rear shoulders.
instructions: Hinge forward with a wide overhand grip.
Keep a flat back.
Row the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

4056.description: Dead bug holding a stability ball between hands and knees. It builds deep core control.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the ball above your chest with your knees raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg away, holding the ball with the rest.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides slowly.

4120.description: A seated one arm Arnold press for shoulders with rotation through the movement.
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in one hand at chest height, palm facing you.
Press up while rotating your palm forward.
Fully extend overhead.
Lower while rotating back.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

4184.description: A dumbbell bench press with a band adding tension at lockout. It builds chest strength.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a band across your upper back and hands.
Hold dumbbells at chest level.
Press up against the band.
Lock out at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet flat.

4248.description: A crunch holding a dumbbell straight above your chest. It loads the abs while your arms stay locked.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms straight up.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms straight and your neck relaxed.

4312.description: A standing side-leaning stretch that opens up the lats and the side of the torso.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.

4376.description: An advanced bodyweight skill where you walk on your hands while inverted. It builds shoulder strength, balance and body control.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.

4440.description: A step-up with a kettlebell, held in a different position, to train the quads and glutes unilaterally.
instructions: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4568.description: A simple band pull-apart to strengthen the back of the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

4696.description: A diagonal twisting movement with a band from low to high. It trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Anchor the band low and stand sideways to it, holding the end with both hands.
Start with your hands near the low hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body as you rotate your torso.
Pivot your back foot and keep your arms long.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.

4760.description: A standing calf raise from a raised platform so your heels drop below the toes. The extra range works the calves hard.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or block, heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise up as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

4824.description: A fast, rotating punch that travels across the body. It raises your heart rate and trains shoulders, core and rotation.
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with your fists up.
Rotate your hips and torso as you throw a punch across your body.
Extend your arm fully and pivot your back foot.
Pull the arm back quickly.
Alternate sides at a brisk, controlled pace.

4888.description: A windmill with the weight held high overhead while you hinge sideways. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and press a dumbbell overhead with one arm.
Turn your feet slightly away from the weighted side.
Push your hips toward the weighted side and hinge forward.
Slide your free hand down your leg while your eyes stay on the dumbbell.
Reverse the movement to stand tall again.
Keep the arm locked and stacked over your shoulder, then switch sides.

5080.description: Hold your arms out and rotate your palms up and down. A simple warm-up for the shoulders and forearms.
instructions: Stand tall and raise your arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Turn your palms up so your thumbs point back.
Rotate them down so your thumbs point forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms level.
Repeat smoothly for 10-15 rotations.

5144.description: Throw a medicine ball hard against a wall from your chest and catch it on the rebound. It builds explosive pressing power.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the ball held at your chest.
Take a small step back and set your feet.
Push the ball forcefully at the wall.
Catch it with soft elbows as it returns.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.

5336.description: A forward lunge holding a kettlebell, a second variation. It builds the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at chest height or by your side.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs.

5400.description: A standing stretch that uses a stick to pull the arm overhead and open up the side of your back. Good for tight lats and overhead mobility.
instructions: Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.

5528.description: Overhead triceps extension on crossed cables for a strong stretch and squeeze.
instructions: Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

5656.description: Face pull with a rope attachment to hit the rear delts.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grab it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

5784.description: A machine squat facing the pad with a vertical lever path. Hits the thighs and glutes with back-friendly support.
instructions: Set the machine and stand with your chest against the pad, feet on the platform.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

5912.description: Sumo deadlift with chains added to the bar for extra resistance near lockout, hitting the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.

5976.description: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
instructions: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.

6232.description: A bodyweight biceps curl on suspension straps. It builds the biceps.
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows high.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body straight.

6296.description: A standing bind pose that straightens one leg upward. It demands balance and flexibility in the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Slowly straighten the lifted leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.

6360.description: Wrist curls using a low cable for steady tension through the whole range, working the inside of your forearms.
instructions: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

6424.description: A hip hinge holding a dumbbell at your chest, training hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

6552.description: A hip hinge using a low cable. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with steady tension.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

6744.description: A squat position with side steps against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and thighs.
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

7384.description: Plate-loaded machine hip thrust for heavy glute work.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

7512.description: Pull-up on rings where you pull toward one hand with the other arm extended.
instructions: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

8536.description: A wall-supported toe raise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the shins.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

8664.description: A lunge where one leg crosses behind you, working the glutes and outer hips with added load.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

9048.description: A mountain climber variation where you bring each knee across toward the opposite elbow. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

9304.description: A wide, neutral grip pulldown on a cable machine that builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.

10200.description: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.
instructions: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.

10328.description: A split squat with your back foot raised, loaded through a belt machine to hit the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

10904.description: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

11288.description: A shrug done with your arms overhead. It wakes up the upper traps and builds shoulder awareness.
instructions: Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

11800.description: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

11864.description: A one-arm curl that pauses at the halfway point to increase biceps tension.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

0024.description: A front squat variation with the bar held on the upper chest, putting the focus on the quads and an upright torso.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper chest, just below your collarbone.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your elbows up and your upper arms parallel to the ground.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上胸部，锁骨下方。
正手握住杠铃，保持肘部向上，上臂与地面平行。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，将身体降低到蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
在深蹲底部暂停片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0088.description: Seated calf raise with the bar resting on your thighs. Isolates the soleus and calves.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform, such as a block or step.
Position the barbell across your thighs and hold it securely with your hands.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, lift your heels off the ground by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，杠铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的平台上，例如木块或台阶。
将杠铃放在大腿上，并用手牢牢握住它。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，伸展脚踝，将脚后跟抬离地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0152.description: A cable triceps extension while kneeling, which keeps the body steady and isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand and place your elbow on the inside of your right knee.
Extend your arm fully, keeping your elbow stationary and close to your knee.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
用右手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部放在右膝盖内侧。
充分伸展手臂，保持肘部静止并靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0216.description: A seated cable shoulder rotation where the arm turns inward. It builds control of the rotator cuff and the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the cable handle with your arm extended straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and your shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Slowly rotate your arm inward, bringing the cable handle towards the center of your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
握住电缆手柄，手臂在身前伸直，与地面平行。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，肩胛骨向后和向下拉。
慢慢向内旋转手臂，将电缆手柄拉向身体中心。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0344.description: A lying one-arm triceps extension with an overhand grip. It isolates the triceps, one side at a time.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back and head supported, and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing down, and extend your arm straight up above your shoulder.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，背部和头部得到支撑，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝下，将手臂伸直至肩膀上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将哑铃降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0408.description: Lying on your side, you raise a dumbbell with one hand. It works the shoulder through a different angle with the body supported.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your arm straight, raise the dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
用你的上手握住哑铃，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，将哑铃举至肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0472.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your legs in front of you. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0536.description: A lunge where you pass the kettlebell around your front leg at the bottom. Works the legs and glutes while challenging your balance and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, pass the kettlebell under your right thigh and transfer it to your left hand.
Push off with your right foot to return to the starting position, while simultaneously passing the kettlebell back to your right hand.
Repeat the lunge on the opposite side, passing the kettlebell under your left thigh.
Continue alternating lunges and passing the kettlebell between hands for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住壶铃放在胸前。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前弓步时，将壶铃传递到右大腿下方，然后将其转移到左手。
用右脚蹬地回到起始位置，同时将壶铃传回右手。
在另一侧重复弓步，将壶铃传递到左大腿下方。
继续交替弓步并在双手之间传递壶铃，达到所需的重复次数。

0600.description: On a machine, you raise your legs while curling your torso. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly raise your legs up towards your chest, curling your torso forward at the same time.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
抓住手柄或侧杆以保持稳定性。
收紧腹肌，慢慢地将双腿抬向胸部，同时向前卷曲躯干。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低双腿和躯干回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0664.description: You do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank. Works the chest, arms, shoulders and obliques.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and rotate your body to the right, lifting your right arm towards the ceiling.
Hold the side plank position for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the push-up and side plank on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
将体重转移到左手上，然后将身体向右旋转，将右臂举向天花板。
保持侧板姿势几秒钟，然后返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复俯卧撑和侧板支撑。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0728.description: Balancing on a stability ball, you extend one leg at a time. It works the quads and balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat.
Keep your torso tall.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Hold briefly.
Lower the foot back down.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0792.description: Driving a bent knee back behind you while standing. It targets the glutes with a short, controlled range.
instructions: Stand tall holding a support, with your core tight.
Shift onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Press that heel back and up, squeezing your glute.
Do not arch your lower back.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

0856.description: A chest squeeze press holding a plate between the palms and pushing it forward. It trains the inner chest and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your palms facing each other.
Press the weight plate straight out in front of you, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring the weight plate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手将杠铃片放在胸前。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌相对。
将配重板直接压在您面前，完全伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将配重板放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0984.description: A lying hip rotation with a band around the feet or legs, rotating the knees out and back. It works the glutes and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your feet.
Bend your knees and bring them towards your chest, keeping your feet together.
Slowly rotate your knees outwards, away from each other, while keeping your feet together.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸直，将阻力带绕在脚上。
弯曲膝盖并将其靠近胸部，双脚并拢。
慢慢向外旋转膝盖，使膝盖彼此远离，同时保持双脚并拢。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
